◉　Plot

　　Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and
　　discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest
　　runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.
